description: This file contains controller functions for user authentication, including login and registration logic, utilizing external modules for database interaction, JWT token creation, password hashing, and validation.

methods.name: loginUser
methods.description: Handles user login by verifying email and password, then generating a JWT token upon success.

methods.name: createToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token using user ID and secret from environment variables.

methods.name: registerUser
methods.description: Handles user registration by validating input, hashing password, saving new user, and returning a JWT token.
